title: Luteoloside attenuates renal Ischemia-Reperfusion injury by suppressing ferroptosis through disruption of the KEAP1-NRF2 interaction.
authors: Qiu, Qiangmin; Zhou, Yujie; Xia, Kang; Yan, Zhiwei; Hui, Yumin; Chen, Zhan; Yu, Bo; Zhu, Jiefu; Qiu, Tao; Zhou, Jiangqiao; Zhang, Ye; Wang, Tianyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物Luteoloside通过调控KEAP1-NRF2蛋白互作抑制肾缺血再灌注损伤中的铁死亡，属于纯湿实验与药理学研究，无AI或物理模拟方法，且对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Renal ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury represents a principal etiological factor in acute kidney injury (AKI), with ferroptosis emerging as a key pathogenic mechanism. Luteoloside (Lut), a natural flavonoid with antioxidative properties, has not yet been well characterized in renal I/R injury. PURPOSE: The study explored the renoprotective effects of Lut and its underlying mechanisms. METHODS: We established renal I/R in C57BL/6 mice and hypoxia/reoxygenation (H/R)-induced injury in HK-2 cells. Transcriptomic analysis was used to investigate Lut-regulated pathways in renal I/R-related pathways. H&E staining, renal function assays, and apoptosis assay were performed to evaluate the protective effect of Lut, whereas ROS assay, MDA assay, iron content assay, and scanning electron microscopy were performed to assess ferroptosis-associated changes. To clarify the mechanism of Lut, molecular docking, CETSA, co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP), and ubiquitination assays were used to examine Lut-KEAP1 interactions and the regulation of NRF2. RESULTS: Lut pretreatment significantly improved renal function after I/R, as evidenced by reduced serum creatinine and blood urea nitrogen levels, and markedly attenuated tubular injury and apoptosis in vivo. Lut reduced reactive oxygen species accumulation, malondialdehyde levels, and labile iron content, while restoring glutathione levels and rescuing GPX4 and SLC7A11 expression that was suppressed by I/R in mouse kidneys and HK-2 cells. Transcriptomic profiling revealed significant enrichment of antioxidant and ferroptosis-related pathways, with prominent activation of NRF2 signaling. Mechanistically, Lut directly bound to KEAP1, disrupted the KEAP1-NRF2 interaction, inhibited NRF2 ubiquitination, and promoted NRF2 nuclear translocation. Genetic silencing or pharmacological inhibition of NRF2 markedly attenuated the antioxidant, anti-ferroptotic, and renoprotective effects of Lut. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates that Lut protects against renal I/R injury by suppressing ferroptosis through direct modulation of the KEAP1-NRF2 axis, supporting Lut as a potential redox-targeted therapy for I/R-induced AKI.
abstract_zh: 背景：肾缺血再灌注（I/R）损伤是急性肾损伤（AKI）的主要病因之一，其中铁死亡（ferroptosis）已成为关键致病机制。木犀草苷（Lut）是一种具有抗氧化特性的天然黄酮类化合物，其在肾I/R损伤中的作用尚未得到充分表征。目的：本研究探讨了Lut的肾脏保护作用及其潜在机制。方法：我们建立了C57BL/6小鼠肾I/R模型及HK-2细胞缺氧/复氧（H/R）诱导损伤模型。利用转录组学分析研究Lut调控的肾I/R相关通路。通过H&E染色、肾功能检测和凋亡检测评估Lut的保护作用，同时采用ROS检测、MDA检测、铁含量检测和扫描电子显微镜评估铁死亡相关变化。为阐明Lut的作用机制，运用分子对接、CETSA、免疫共沉淀（Co-IP）和泛素化检测分析Lut-KEAP1相互作用及NRF2的调控。结果：Lut预处理显著改善I/R后肾功能，表现为血清肌酐和血尿素氮水平降低，并在体内明显减轻肾小管损伤和凋亡。Lut减少活性氧积累、丙二醛水平和不稳定铁含量，同时恢复谷胱甘肽水平并挽救小鼠肾脏和HK-2细胞中受I/R抑制的GPX4和SLC7A11表达。转录组分析显示抗氧化和铁死亡相关通路显著富集，其中NRF2信号通路明显激活。机制上，Lut直接结合KEAP1，破坏KEAP1-NRF2相互作用，抑制NRF2泛素化，并促进NRF2核转位。NRF2的基因沉默或药理学抑制显著减弱了Lut的抗氧化、抗铁死亡和肾脏保护作用。结论：本研究证明Lut通过直接调控KEAP1-NRF2轴抑制铁死亡，从而保护肾I/R损伤，支持Lut作为I/R诱导AKI的潜在氧化还原靶向治疗药物。
